title: Process Technology
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

outcomes: Be academically and experientially prepared to obtain an entry-level position in the chemical, refining, oil and gas production, water, waste management, food, and related manufacturing industries.

Apply critical thinking to research, evaluate, analyze and synthesize information to solve problems related to process equipment, instruments, systems, and operations within the chemical, refining, oil and gas production, water, waste management, food, and related manufacturing industries.

Demonstrate excellent communications skills (oral and written) to ensure optimal communication with shift co-workers, first line supervisors, maintenance personnel, safety personnel, contractors, and other members of the manufacturing site team.

notes: The catalog prints codes without a space between subject and number (e.g., 'COMPB5', 'ELETB1A'); recorded with a space to match the closed list format.

Catalog titles differ from the closed list: COMP B5 is printed as 'Introduction to Microsoft Office' (closed list: 'Introduction to Microsoft 365'); ELET B1B is printed as 'Electronic Circuits (AC and Analog)' (closed list: 'Industrial Electricity'). Reviewer may wish to confirm these are the same courses.

The requirements text mentions 'the required general education pattern' and 'courses required for the major', which reads like degree language on a certificate page; no GE pattern is named, so ge_pattern is null.
Grade language is inconsistent: one paragraph says a 'P' grade is not acceptable, while another says at least a 'C' or 'P' grade in each course.
Total of 24 units is printed for the certificate as '(Total 24)'; no separate block total is printed.
